tagline: Creating sustainable, energy-efficient, fire-safe and circular buildings
hero_kpi_rationale: EBIT margin is the primary operational performance indicator for ROCKWOOL, reflecting industrial efficiency, energy cost management and resilience through building cycles. It is a key driver of profitability trajectory despite the absence of a technology wave like AI.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company over the year.
kpis.description: Revenue grew 6% in local currencies, driven by strong demand in Eastern Europe and South and Southeast Asia markets.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by Eastern Europe and Asia.

kpis.name: EBIT Margin
kpis.description: EBIT margin reached 17.5% in 2024, up 3.2 percentage points thanks to improved productivity, effective energy cost management and strong North America performance.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement driven by operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual spending for new facilities or capacity.
kpis.description: Capex forecast of EUR 450M in 2025, excluding acquisitions, to strengthen capacity, modernize technology and decarbonize factories.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in decarbonization and capacity.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Total financial debt minus available cash.
kpis.description: The company maintains a robust financial structure with net debt-free position, supported by strong cash flow.
kpis.signal: Solid balance sheet with no net debt.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: Employee count is not mentioned in the provided excerpts.

kpis.name: CO2 Reduction via Electrification (Flums)
kpis.explanation: CO2 emissions reduction achieved through electrification of the furnace at the Flums plant in Switzerland.
kpis.description: Electrification of the Flums factory furnace (Switzerland) achieved a 75% reduction in CO2 emissions, equivalent to 25,000 tonnes per year.
kpis.signal: Major emissions reduction at the Flums facility.

kpis.name: Green Electricity Coverage in Europe
kpis.explanation: Percentage of electricity used in Europe sourced from renewable sources via energy attribute certificates.
kpis.description: In 2024, all electricity used at European factories was covered by renewable energy attribute certificates (EAC).

risks.title: Dependence on European energy renovation and regulatory risk
risks.score_rationale: Major risk flagged from the outset (EPBD, Energy Efficiency directives). Intensive language: table is set, what matters now is delivery. Trend stable but dependent on national implementation. High category weight: Europe = 50%+ of revenue, growth conditional on legislative adoption.

risks.title: Loss of control and impairment of Russian portfolio
risks.score_rationale: Critical event occurred in January 2026: external administration imposed by Russian authorities. Very direct language: effectively taking control, fully impaired. Cash loss of EUR 243M. Trend: down (materialized risk). Weight: 2025 EBIT impact of -EUR 392M, representing 69% of EBIT decline.

risks.title: Fire safety and product liability (combustible materials)
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly raised: fire safety remains high on the agenda. Alert language: combustible materials can turn a small incident into a catastrophic failure. Trend stable but vigilance required. Category weight: major reputational and regulatory issue for insulation industry.

risks.title: Occupational health and safety: fatalities and serious incidents
risks.score_rationale: Two deaths in Russia in 2025 and increase in serious incidents despite LTI rate improvement. Language: much more work to do, negative trend. Trend: up (serious incidents rising). Weight: critical ESG issue, impact on reputation and regulatory compliance.

risks.title: Construction market volatility and geographic concentration risk
risks.score_rationale: 2026 outlook explicit: slightly positive but varied, low overall construction activity in Europe. Language: Germany and France challenged, Canada muted. Trend stable but fragmented. Weight: concentrated exposure (Germany, France = ~30% of revenue).

risks.title: Tariff and commercial risks (North America)
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: tariff and other trade-related uncertainties impacting Canada. Language moderate but direct. Trend: up (US-Europe tensions rising). Weight: Canada = ~5-7% of revenue, but risk of escalation.

risks.title: Capital intensity and investment execution risk
risks.score_rationale: Substantial investments announced: EUR 650M in 2026 (vs EUR 486M in 2025), of which 82% taxonomy-aligned. Language: significant investment, each factory project. Trend: up (acceleration). Weight: Capex to revenue ~13-18%, risk of overrun or delay.

risks.title: Dependence on electrification and energy supply agreements
risks.score_rationale: Decarbonization strategy hinges on furnace electrification (EUR 389M in 2025) and PPAs (Power Purchase Agreements signed in Poland and Spain). Language: systematically improving. Trend: up (growing commitment). Weight: critical for achieving Net Zero 2050 targets.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. ROCKWOOL's strategy focuses on sustainability, decarbonization and industrial efficiency.
evidence: No reference to AI, APIs, algorithms or advanced automation.
Cited innovations concern furnace electrification and energy efficiency.
Key indicators are tied to environmental and operational performance, not digital technology.
